# Backend Guide - Microservices Architecture
## ️ Architecture Overview
Backend được xây dựng theo **microservices** pattern với các thành phần:
``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Client (Frontend) │ └────────────┬────────────────────────┘ │ HTTP/REST ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐ │ API Gateway (Port 8080) │ ← Route requests to services │ (Spring Cloud Gateway) │ └────────────┬────────────────────────┘ │ ┌─────────┼─────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ┌─────┐ ┌─────┐ ┌─────┐ ┌─────┐ ┌─────┐ │Auth │ │Prod │ │Cart │ │Order│ │Pay │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ └─────┘ └─────┘ └─────┘ └─────┘ └─────┘ │ │ │ │ │ └─────────┼─────────┼─────────┼─────────┘ │ Service-to-Service Communication ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────┐ │ Service Discovery │ │ (Eureka - Port 8761) │ └─────────────────────────────┘
Database Layer (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, etc.) Event Bus (Kafka) Event Store (AxonServer) ```
---
## Backend Project Structure
``` backend/ ├── discovery-service/ (Service Registry) │ ├── src/main/java/ │ │ └── com/flashsale/discovery/ │ │ └── DiscoveryServiceApplication.java │ ├── pom.xml │ └── Dockerfile │ ├── api-gateway/ (Request Router) │ ├── src/main/java/ │ │ └── com/flashsale/gateway/ │ ├── src/main/resources/ │ │ └── application.yml (Route definitions) │ ├── pom.xml │ └── Dockerfile │ ├── identity-service/ (Users & Auth) │ ├── src/main/java/ │ │ └── com/flashsale/identity/ │ │ ├── controller/ │ │ ├── service/ │ │ ├── repository/ │ │ └── entity/ │ ├── src/main/resources/ │ │ └── application.yml │ ├── pom.xml │ └── Dockerfile │ ├── product-service/ (Products) │ ├── src/main/java/ │ │ └── com/flashsale/product/ │ ├── pom.xml │ └── Dockerfile │ ├── order-service/ (Orders) ├── payment-service/ (Payments) ├── cart-service/ (Shopping Cart) ├── flashsale-service/ (Flash Sales) ├── search-service/ (Search) ├── notification-service/ (Notifications) ├── worker-service/ (Background Jobs) │ ├── common-lib/ (Shared Libraries) │ ├── src/main/java/ │ │ └── com/flashsale/common/ │ │ ├── dto/ (Shared DTOs) │ │ ├── entity/ │ │ ├── exception/ │ │ └── util/ │ └── pom.xml │ ├── docker/ (Initialization Scripts) │ ├── postgres/ │ │ └── init/ │ ├── mongo/ │ │ └── init/ │ └── axon/ │ └── init/ │ └── pom.xml (Parent POM) ```
---
## Setup & Build Backend
### Prerequisites
```bash # Java 25 (Latest LTS) java -version # Should show: openjdk version "25"
# Maven 3.8+ mvn -version ```
**Note**: Project is configured with **Java 25** and **Spring Boot 4.0.4**. For more details, see [JAVA_SPRING_BOOT_CONFIG.md](./JAVA_SPRING_BOOT_CONFIG.md)
### Build All Services
```bash cd backend
# Clean and build all mvn clean install
# Skip tests (faster) mvn clean install -DskipTests
# Build specific service cd identity-service mvn clean package ```
### Run Individual Services Locally
```bash # Terminal 1 - Discovery Service (Eureka) cd backend/discovery-service mvn spring-boot:run # Runs on http://localhost:8761
# Terminal 2 - API Gateway cd backend/api-gateway mvn spring-boot:run # Runs on http://localhost:8080
# Terminal 3 - Identity Service cd backend/identity-service mvn spring-boot:run # Runs on http://localhost:8085
# Terminal 4+ - Other Services # Each runs on different port (see application.yml) ```
---
## ️ Database Setup
### PostgreSQL (Identity, Order, Payment Services)
```bash # Using Docker docker run -d \ --name flashsale-postgres \ -e POSTGRES_USER=flashsale \ -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=password123 \ -e POSTGRES_DB=flashsale \ -p 5432:5432 \ postgres:15-alpine
# Or using docker-compose docker-compose up -d postgres ```
**Initialize Database**: ```bash # SQL migration files are in backend/docker/postgres/init/ # They auto-run when PostgreSQL starts # Or manually: psql -U flashsale -d flashsale -f backend/docker/postgres/init/01-init-db.sql ```
### MongoDB (Product, Notification Services)
```bash # Using Docker docker run -d \ --name flashsale-mongo \ -e MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME=admin \ -e MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD=password123 \ -p 27017:27017 \ mongo:6.0
# Or using docker-compose docker-compose up -d mongo ```
### Redis (Cache)
```bash docker run -d \ --name flashsale-redis \ -p 6379:6379 \ redis:7-alpine
# Or docker-compose up -d redis ```
---
## Service Configuration
Each service has an `application.yml` with:
```yaml spring: application: name: identity-service datasource: url: jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/flashsale_identity username: root password: password
eureka: client: service-url: defaultZone: http://localhost:8761/eureka/ instance: prefer-ip-address: true ip-address: localhost
server: port: 8085 # Each service has unique port ```
---
## API Gateway Configuration
Routes are defined in `api-gateway/src/main/resources/application.yml`:
```yaml spring: cloud: gateway: routes: - id: identity-service uri: lb://identity-service predicates: - Path=/api/v1/auth/**,/api/v1/users/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
- id: product-service uri: lb://product-service predicates: - Path=/api/v1/products/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
# Add more routes... ```
**How it works**: - Client: `GET /api/v1/products` - Gateway: Strips `/api/v1` → `/products` - Routes to: `product-service/products`
---
## Authentication Flow
``` 1. User Login POST /api/v1/auth/login
2. Backend validates credentials
3. Return JWT Token { "accessToken": "eyJhbGc...", "refreshToken": "..." }
4. Frontend stores token in HttpOnly cookie
5. Subsequent requests include token Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...
6. API Gateway validates token
7. Request forwarded to service ```
---
## Inter-Service Communication
Services communicate via:
1. **HTTP/REST** (Synchronous) ```java // Service A calls Service B RestTemplate restTemplate = new RestTemplate(); String response = restTemplate.getForObject( "http://service-b/api/...", String.class ); ```
2. **Kafka** (Asynchronous) ```java // Service A publishes event kafkaTemplate.send("order-events", orderEvent);
// Service B listens @KafkaListener(topics = "order-events") public void handleOrderEvent(OrderEvent event) { } ```
3. **gRPC** (Efficient) ```protobuf // Define in .proto files service ProductService { rpc GetProduct (ProductId) returns (Product); } ```
---
## Event Sourcing with Axon Framework
### Axon Framework Architecture
The project uses **Axon Framework 4.13.0** for **Event Sourcing** and **CQRS** pattern:
``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ AXON FRAMEWORK │ │ (Công cụ để xây dựng Event-Driven Architecture) │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ │ 1. COMMAND HANDLER (tiếp nhận lệnh) │ │ 2. EVENT STORE (lưu trữ event) │ │ 3. EVENT HANDLER (xử lý event) │ │ 4. SAGA (điều phối distributed transaction) │ │ 5. PROJECTION (tạo read model tối ưu) │ │ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ```
### Services Using Axon
✅ **Event Sourcing Enabled**: - `order-service` - Order aggregate & saga - `payment-service` - Payment aggregate - `flashsale-service` - FlashSale aggregate - `worker-service` - Background job saga
❌ **Traditional Databases**: - `identity-service` - JPA + PostgreSQL - `product-service` - MongoDB - `cart-service` - Redis - `search-service` - Elasticsearch - `notification-service` - MongoDB - `api-gateway` - Request routing
For detailed explanation, see **[AXON_EXPLANATION.md](./AXON_EXPLANATION.md)**
---
## Testing Backend
```bash # Run all tests mvn test
# Run specific test class mvn test -Dtest=UserServiceTest
# Run with coverage mvn test jacoco:report
# Integration tests mvn verify
# Load testing # Use tools like JMeter, Gatling ```
---
## Monitoring & Logging
### Logs ```bash # View logs from Docker docker-compose logs -f identity-service
# View specific service docker-compose logs -f api-gateway --tail 100 ```
### Health Checks ```bash # Each service has health endpoint curl http://localhost:8080/actuator/health
# Full health info curl http://localhost:8080/actuator/health/livenessState ```
### Metrics ```bash # Prometheus metrics curl http://localhost:8080/actuator/prometheus ```
---
## Deployment
### Docker Build
```bash # Build individual service cd backend/identity-service docker build -t identity-service:latest .
# Build all via docker-compose docker-compose build ```
### Production Deployment
```bash # Using docker-compose docker-compose up -d
# Using Kubernetes kubectl apply -f k8s/
# Using Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) # See deployment guides ```
---
## Common Issues
### Service won't connect to database
```bash # Check if database is running docker-compose ps postgres
# Check credentials in application.yml # Check firewall settings ```
### Service can't find other services
```bash # Ensure Eureka is running curl http://localhost:8761
# Service registered? curl http://localhost:8761/eureka/apps ```
### Port already in use
```bash # Kill process lsof -i :8080 | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}' | xargs kill -9
# Or change port in application.yml server: port: 8081 ```
---
## Reference
- [Spring Boot Docs](https://spring.io/projects/spring-boot) - [Spring Cloud Gateway](https://spring.io/projects/spring-cloud-gateway) - [Eureka](https://github.com/Netflix/eureka/wiki) - [Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/) - [Axon Framework](https://docs.axoniq.io/) - [JAVA_SPRING_BOOT_CONFIG.md](./JAVA_SPRING_BOOT_CONFIG.md) - Java 25 & Spring Boot 4.0.4 - [AXON_EXPLANATION.md](./AXON_EXPLANATION.md) - Axon Framework detailed guide
---
**Backend is production-ready! **

### Event Flow in Axon Service
``` 1. REST API Call POST /orders
2. Controller OrderController.createOrder()
3. Command Bus commandGateway.send(new CreateOrderCommand(...))
4. Command Handler (in Aggregate) @CommandHandler OrderAggregate.handle(CreateOrderCommand cmd)
5. Event Sourcing - Validate - Generate: OrderCreatedEvent - Store in Axon Server
6. Event Handlers (Projections) @EventHandler OrderProjection.on(OrderCreatedEvent evt) - Update PostgreSQL read model - Send notifications
7. Saga Triggers @EventHandler OrderSaga.on(OrderCreatedEvent evt) - Call PaymentService - Call ShippingService - Handle compensation if fail
8. Query Response GET /orders/{id} - Query handler reads from projection (PostgreSQL) - Returns OrderResponse ```
### Example: Creating an Order with Axon
**1. Aggregate (domain/OrderAggregate.java)** ```java @Aggregate public class OrderAggregate { @AggregateIdentifier private OrderId orderId; private String userId; private List<OrderItem> items; private OrderStatus status;
@CommandHandler public OrderAggregate(CreateOrderCommand cmd) { // Validate AggregateLifecycle.apply(new OrderCreatedEvent( cmd.getOrderId(), cmd.getUserId(), cmd.getItems() )); }
@EventSourcingHandler public void on(OrderCreatedEvent event) { this.orderId = event.getOrderId(); this.userId = event.getUserId(); this.items = event.getItems(); this.status = OrderStatus.PENDING; } } ```
**2. Projection (projection/OrderProjection.java)** ```java @Service public class OrderProjection { @Autowired private OrderViewRepository viewRepo;
@EventHandler public void on(OrderCreatedEvent event) { OrderView view = new OrderView(); view.setOrderId(event.getOrderId()); view.setUserId(event.getUserId()); view.setStatus(OrderStatus.PENDING); viewRepo.save(view); // Persist to PostgreSQL } } ```
**3. Query Handler (query/OrderQueryHandler.java)** ```java @Component public class OrderQueryHandler { @Autowired private OrderViewRepository viewRepo;
@QueryHandler public OrderResponse handle(GetOrderByIdQuery query) { OrderView view = viewRepo.findById(query.getOrderId()) .orElseThrow(); return OrderResponse.from(view); } } ```
**4. REST Controller (api/OrderController.java)** ```java @RestController @RequestMapping("/api/orders") public class OrderController { @Autowired private CommandGateway commandGateway; @Autowired private QueryGateway queryGateway;
@PostMapping public ResponseEntity<?> createOrder(@RequestBody CreateOrderRequest req) { String orderId = UUID.randomUUID().toString(); commandGateway.send( new CreateOrderCommand(orderId, req.getUserId(), req.getItems()) ); return ResponseEntity.ok().body(Map.of("orderId", orderId)); }
@GetMapping("/{orderId}") public ResponseEntity<OrderResponse> getOrder(@PathVariable String orderId) { OrderResponse response = queryGateway.query( new GetOrderByIdQuery(orderId), ResponseTypes.instanceOf(OrderResponse.class) ).join(); return ResponseEntity.ok(response); } } ```
### Axon Configuration (application.yml)
```yaml spring: application: name: order-service jpa: hibernate: ddl-auto: update properties: hibernate: dialect: org.hibernate.dialect.PostgreSQL11Dialect
axon: axonserver: client: server-name: axonserver:8124 # Axon Server address component-name: order-service # Service name eventhandling: processors: default: mode: subscribing # Listen to events serializer: general: jackson events: jackson
server: port: 8087 # Order Service port ```
### Dependencies in pom.xml
```xml <!-- Axon Framework --> <dependency> <groupId>org.axonframework</groupId> <artifactId>axon-spring-boot-starter</artifactId> </dependency>
<!-- PostgreSQL (for projections/read model) --> <dependency> <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId> <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId> <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId> </dependency>
<!-- Spring Cloud for service discovery --> <dependency> <groupId>org.springframework.cloud</groupId> <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-netflix-eureka-client</artifactId> </dependency> ```
### ✅ Comparison: Axon vs Traditional Services

name: Build & Deploy (Build on Server)
on: push: branches: - main - develop workflow_dispatch:
jobs: # ======================================== # QUICK VALIDATION (GitHub Actions) # ======================================== quick-validation: name: Quick Code Validation runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Check files exist run: | echo "✓ Checking backend pom.xml..." test -f backend/pom.xml && echo "✓ Found" || exit 1
echo "✓ Checking frontend apps..." test -d frontend/apps/customer && echo "✓ Found customer app" test -d frontend/apps/seller && echo "✓ Found seller app" test -d frontend/apps/admin && echo "✓ Found admin app"
echo "✓ Checking docker-compose.yml..." test -f docker-compose.yml && echo "✓ Found"
# ======================================== # BUILD & DEPLOY ON SERVER # ======================================== deploy-on-server: name: Build & Deploy on Server runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: quick-validation if: github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop')
steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Install SSH key run: | mkdir -p ~/.ssh echo "${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}" > ~/.ssh/id_rsa chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_rsa ssh-keyscan -H ${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }} >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null || true
- name: Deploy to server (Build on Host) run: | # Create comprehensive deployment script cat > deploy.sh << 'DEPLOY_EOF' #!/bin/bash set -e
echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗" echo "║ FLASHSALE DEPLOYMENT - BUILD ON SERVER ║" echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
# Colors RED='\033[0;31m' GREEN='\033[0;32m' YELLOW='\033[1;33m' BLUE='\033[0;34m' NC='\033[0m'
log_info() { echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1" }
log_success() { echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1" }
log_warning() { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1" }
log_error() { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1" }
PROJECT_DIR="/opt/flashsale"
# ====== STEP 1: INITIALIZE ====== log_info "Step 1: Initializing deployment..."
# Check if repo is directly in /opt/flashsale or in subfolder if [ -d "$PROJECT_DIR/.git" ]; then # Repo cloned correctly to /opt/flashsale cd "$PROJECT_DIR" log_success "Found repo at $PROJECT_DIR" elif [ -d "$PROJECT_DIR/stealing-from-paradise/.git" ]; then # Repo cloned into subfolder (stealing-from-paradise/) PROJECT_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR/stealing-from-paradise" cd "$PROJECT_DIR" log_warning "Found repo in subfolder, using: $PROJECT_DIR" else log_error "Git repository not found at $PROJECT_DIR" exit 1 fi
log_success "Project directory ready: $PROJECT_DIR"
# ====== STEP 2: GIT PULL ====== log_info "Step 2: Pulling latest code from repository..."
if [ ! -d .git ]; then log_error "Not a git repository!" exit 1 fi
git fetch origin git reset --hard origin/main git clean -fd log_success "Code updated"
# ====== STEP 3: SETUP ENVIRONMENT ====== log_info "Step 3: Setting up environment variables..."
if [ ! -f .env ]; then if [ -f .env.example ]; then cp .env.example .env log_warning "Created .env from .env.example - PLEASE UPDATE WITH YOUR ACTUAL VALUES!" else log_error ".env.example not found" exit 1 fi fi
log_success "Environment ready"
# ====== STEP 4: CHECK PREREQUISITES ====== log_info "Step 4: Checking prerequisites..."
if ! command -v java &> /dev/null; then log_error "Java not found. Install Java 25+" exit 1 fi JAVA_VERSION=$(java -version 2>&1 | head -n 1) log_success "Java found: $JAVA_VERSION"
if ! command -v mvn &> /dev/null; then log_error "Maven not found. Install Maven" exit 1 fi log_success "Maven found"
if ! command -v node &> /dev/null; then log_error "Node.js not found. Install Node.js 18+" exit 1 fi NODE_VERSION=$(node --version) log_success "Node.js found: $NODE_VERSION"
if ! command -v npm &> /dev/null; then log_error "npm not found" exit 1 fi log_success "npm found"
if ! command -v docker &> /dev/null; then log_error "Docker not found. Install Docker" exit 1 fi log_success "Docker found"
# ====== STEP 5: BUILD BACKEND ====== log_info "Step 5: Building backend with Maven..."
cd "$PROJECT_DIR/backend" log_info "Running: mvn clean package -DskipTests -q" mvn clean package -DskipTests -q
log_success "Backend JAR files created in target/ folders" cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
# ====== STEP 6: BUILD FRONTEND (optional - for verification) ====== log_info "Step 6: Building frontend locally for testing (optional)..."
# Frontend will be built inside Docker multi-stage build # But we can verify builds locally first for app in customer seller admin; do log_info "Verifying $app app source files..." if [ ! -d "frontend/apps/$app" ]; then log_error "$app app directory not found" exit 1 fi done
log_success "Frontend apps verified"
# ====== STEP 7: STOP OLD SERVICES ====== log_info "Step 7: Stopping current services..."
if [ -f docker-compose.yml ]; then docker-compose down || true log_success "Old services stopped" fi
# ====== STEP 8: BUILD DOCKER IMAGES ====== log_info "Step 8: Building Docker images from compiled artifacts..."
log_info "Building backend service Docker images..." log_info "(Docker will COPY pre-built JAR files from target/ folders)"
SERVICES=( "discovery-service" "api-gateway" "identity-service" "product-service" "order-service" "payment-service" "cart-service" "flashsale-service" "search-service" "notification-service" "worker-service" )
for service in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do SERVICE_DIR="backend/$service" if [ -d "$SERVICE_DIR" ]; then # Check if target/ exists (from Maven build) if [ ! -d "$SERVICE_DIR/target" ]; then log_error "$service target/ not found. Maven build may have failed." exit 1 fi
log_info "Building $service Docker image..." # Build from service directory so Dockerfile can COPY target/ docker build -t flashsale_$service:latest "$SERVICE_DIR" log_success "$service image built" fi done
log_info "Building frontend application Docker images..." log_info "(Frontend Docker images use multi-stage build - npm build happens inside Docker)"
for app in customer seller admin; do if [ -d "frontend/apps/$app" ]; then log_info "Building $app-app Docker image..." # Build from frontend root so Dockerfile can COPY apps/$app/** docker build -t flashsale_${app}_app:latest \ -f ./frontend/apps/$app/Dockerfile \ --build-arg APP_PATH=apps/$app \ ./frontend log_success "$app-app image built" fi done
log_success "All Docker images built successfully"
# ====== STEP 9: START SERVICES ====== log_info "Step 9: Starting services with docker-compose..."
docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d
log_success "Services started"
# ====== STEP 10: WAIT FOR HEALTH CHECKS ====== log_info "Step 10: Waiting for services to stabilize (30 seconds)..." sleep 30
# ====== STEP 11: VERIFY DEPLOYMENT ====== log_info "Step 11: Verifying deployment..."
if curl -sf http://localhost:8080/actuator/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then log_success "✓ API Gateway is healthy" else log_warning "⚠ API Gateway is still starting..." fi
log_info "Running containers:" docker-compose ps
echo "" echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗" echo "║ ✓ DEPLOYMENT COMPLETE ║" echo "╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣" echo "║ API Gateway: http://localhost:8080 ║" echo "║ Customer App: http://localhost:3000 ║" echo "║ Seller App: http://localhost:3001 ║" echo "║ Admin App: http://localhost:3002 ║" echo "║ Eureka: http://localhost:8761 ║" echo "║ Swagger: http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html ║" echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
log_success "All services deployed successfully!"
DEPLOY_EOF
chmod +x deploy.sh
# Copy and execute on server scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=~/.ssh/known_hosts \ -o ConnectTimeout=10 \ deploy.sh ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}@${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }}:/tmp/deploy.sh
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=~/.ssh/known_hosts \ -o ConnectTimeout=10 \ ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}@${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }} 'bash /tmp/deploy.sh'
- name: Verify deployment run: | sleep 5 echo " Verifying deployment..." if curl -sf http://${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }}:8080/actuator/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "✓ API Gateway is responding" else echo "⚠ API Gateway may still be starting, check server logs" fi
- name: Show deployment info run: | echo "" echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" echo " DEPLOYMENT INFORMATION" echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" echo "Server: ${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }}" echo "Branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}" echo "Commit: ${{ github.sha }}" echo "" echo " Access Applications:" echo " • API Gateway: http://${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }}:8080" echo " • Customer: http://${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }}:3000" echo " • Seller: http://${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }}:3001" echo " • Admin: http://${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }}:3002" echo " • Eureka: http://${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }}:8761" echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" echo ""
# ======================================== # NOTIFICATION # ======================================== notify: name: Notify Status runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: deploy-on-server if: always()
steps: - name: Deployment Result run: | echo "" if [ "${{ needs.deploy-on-server.result }}" == "success" ]; then echo "✅ ✅ ✅ DEPLOYMENT SUCCESSFUL ✅ ✅ ✅" echo "" echo "Server: ${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }}" echo "Branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}" echo "Commit: ${{ github.sha }}" echo "" echo " All services are now running on the server!" else echo "❌ ❌ ❌ DEPLOYMENT FAILED ❌ ❌ ❌" echo "" echo "Check logs: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}" echo "" echo "SSH to server and check logs:" echo " ssh ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}@${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }}" echo " cd /opt/flashsale && docker-compose logs" fi echo ""
